scenario.title: Model facts, execution levels and capacity
situations: The user wants cheaper or stronger workers.
A new model appears or a level cannot launch.
scenario.current: Production Settings and the 18-row universe definition verified on 2026-10-13. Admission, native expansion and predecessor rules traced to current source; this record does not certify every external account or harness.
scenario.desired: Keep catalog facts separate from staffing thresholds; use live native listings and launch preview for placement.
questions: Future model or native-provider changes need fresh catalog/listing evidence; the dated Settings capture does not prove universal launch readiness.

lessons.title: Separate facts from staffing policy
lessons.when: Looking up a model or proposing a level change
lessons.need: Catalog research holds sourced model facts, efforts, successors and effective dates; levels hold ordered model/min_effort thresholds. Catalog updates do not silently change approved preferences. Unknown models or unpublished effort establish no level: item/task claims and work launches refuse session_below_intern; refresh catalog/native facts or select a supported model and effort before retrying. Known older models without explicit rows demote one class at the same effort; bottom-class predecessors and single-class Grok refuse.
lessons.surface: Yoke Help -> Models skill; docs sidebar -> CLI/config -> model reference and execution levels.
lessons.review: Admission and predecessor behavior observed in the shipped routing guide and source; live 18-row definition reread 2026-10-13.

lessons.title: Read effective levels and real capacity
lessons.when: Before choosing a worker level or explaining why staffing is blocked
lessons.need: Project override wins over universe/default levels. Settings Levels shows #, MODEL, MIN EFFORT, NOW and harness chips. Read live native/machine/quota blockers and preview placement. Cursor Models and Other Models have one editable universe-wide consumption order; the earlier pool is preferred before headroom and does not change membership. Unknown meters are not exhausted; no level borrows another level.
lessons.surface: Settings → Levels → four-column model/effort table and two-row Cursor quota order; CLI level-summary/capacity and launch preview.
lessons.review: Production launch.622 QA run 45473 / artifact 32323 proves the visible rows, columns, chips and quota panel; Levels and quota order reread 2026-10-13. Placement semantics observed in source.
recipes: yoke session-control launch preview --project P --level SENIOR
yoke universe cursor-quota-order set --pool 'Cursor Models' --pool 'Other Models'

lessons.title: Inspect native availability and support limits
lessons.when: A requested model/effort/context is missing or refused
lessons.need: Per-machine native listings expand base-model/min_effort rows to selectors. Exact surface/model/effort/context requests bypass level placement and cannot combine with --level. Surface and context are not stored row fields. Unknown/stale/unsupported listings are distinct; probe unknown listings, and obtain a declared adapter or choose an observed surface for unsupported listings. Preserve each refusal and recovery; unresolved model/effort cannot admit work, and no hidden fallback may borrow a different level.
lessons.surface: CLI/config observed-model section -> list-models and probe help; Steer exact-model recipe.
lessons.review: Native expansion and exact-override behavior observed in current routing docs/source. This worker launch receipt confirms the named unsupported-listing and unavailable-model/effort refusals; no all-harness launch success claimed.
